source:
# Continuous Vision is ordinary composition. Acquisition remains outside this
# Plot; generic pressure admits only the newest pending image under load.
plot vision (
    >> images: ImageResource...|
    experience: $VisualExperience >>
) {
    ingress: flow/coalesce-latest
    normalize: vision/normalize
    motion: vision/local-motion
    objects: vision/local-objects
    text: vision/local-ocr
    tracks: vision/local-track
    describe: vision/model-describe
    relate: vision/relate-experience

    images >> ingress.in
    ingress.out >> normalize.source
    normalize.normalized >> motion.image
    normalize.normalized >> objects.image
    normalize.normalized >> text.image
    normalize.normalized >> describe.image
    objects.detections >> tracks.detections
    objects.detections >> describe.detections
    objects.detections >> relate.detections
    text.texts >> describe.texts
    text.texts >> relate.texts
    tracks.tracks >> describe.tracks
    tracks.tracks >> relate.tracks
    motion.motions >> relate.motions
    describe.impression >> relate.impression
    relate.experience >> experience
}
